description: Ten prompts covering the chart kinds and group behaviours added by chart-enhancement L1 through C3b-2a: histogram (equal width, explicit edges, density), boxplot (multi-device and single-table), heatmap with missing cells, stacked and percent bars, a chart group with a failing member and shared colours, the EMPTY-result guard, and a two-category bar. Uses the existing ten-turn driver unchanged.

datasetManifest.baseline: User-restored ThingWorx Stream/ValueStream history; record the restored snapshot with live results

knownCoverage.timeseries: contactForce and operationalVoltage for ORD-Contacting-01/02, 2026-09-14 22:00 to 2026-09-15 02:00 America/New_York, about one sample per six minutes (37 per series). MUC BenchScale 02 has operationalVoltage but no contactForce property.

datasetManifest.promptPolicy: Prompts state explicit dates and do not name a timezone; the submitted user timezone is America/New_York.
knownLimits: Since Agent 0.1.245 a complete JSON result above 20 rows (hasMore false, or equal totalRows/returnedRows) is promoted to a cached table; get_utilization_records returns 25 rows for 2025-09-03..2025-09-14 and the event-record turns use that full window.
tabulate_cached_result mode union_rows appends per-day or per-device tables with a label column; turns 3 and 10 depend on it. Nothing pages or re-queries automatically.
Grouped and stacked bars accept at most 6 series; the records window holds 8 distinct reasons, so the stacked turns use utilizationState as the series.

turns.prompt: Show the distribution of contactForce for ORD-Contacting-01 from September 14, 2026 22:00 to September 15, 2026 02:00 as a histogram with 8 bins.
turns.judgmentFocus: Equal-width histogram: history fetch, bin_numeric with binCount 8, then kind histogram.

turns.prompt: Show a histogram of contactForce for ORD-Contacting-01 from September 14, 2026 22:00 to September 15, 2026 02:00 using bin edges 80, 100, 120, 160, 180, in density mode.
turns.judgmentFocus: Explicit unequal edges with out-of-range values and density mode.

turns.prompt: Show a box plot comparing contactForce across ORD-Contacting-01, ORD-Contacting-02 and MUC BenchScale 02 from September 14, 2026 22:00 to September 15, 2026 02:00, and add an upper spec limit line at 190.
turns.judgmentFocus: Natural three-device comparison: one history per device, union_rows with a device label, box_summary grouped by device. MUC BenchScale 02 has no contactForce: PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND, never the whole value stream.

turns.prompt: Using the utilization event records for ORD-Contacting-01 from 2025-09-03 through 2025-09-14, show a box plot of event duration in seconds grouped by utilization state.
turns.judgmentFocus: Grouped boxplot over the full twelve-day records window: 25 JSON rows with hasMore false, promoted to a cached table (TR-1), then box_summary with groupBy utilizationState.

turns.prompt: From the same utilization event records for ORD-Contacting-01 from 2025-09-03 through 2025-09-14, show a heatmap of total event duration by utilization state and reason.
turns.judgmentFocus: Two-key group_metric long table drawn as a heatmap with missing combinations kept missing.

turns.prompt: From the same utilization event records for ORD-Contacting-01 from 2025-09-03 through 2025-09-14, show total event duration by reason group as a stacked bar chart, stacked by utilization state.
turns.judgmentFocus: Stacked bar over a two-key long table: reasonGroup categories, utilizationState series (at most 6 series; stacking by the 8 distinct reasons is rejected with TOO_MANY_SERIES).

turns.prompt: Now show the same data as a 100% stacked bar chart, horizontally.
turns.judgmentFocus: Follow-up: percent stacking combined with horizontal orientation.

turns.prompt: Show separate pie charts of the utilization-state breakdown on 2025-09-10 for ORD-Contacting-01, ORD-Contacting-02 and AC-Contacting-01, as one comparable group.
turns.judgmentFocus: Three-member chart group with shared colours; a later member appends a category the first ones lack.

turns.prompt: Show a pie chart of the utilization-state breakdown for ORD-Contacting-01 on 2025-09-10, and then a histogram of contactForce for ORD-Contacting-01 on January 1, 2020.
turns.judgmentFocus: Empty distribution result must not chart the earlier table.

turns.prompt: Show a heatmap of the utilization-state percentage for ORD-Contacting-01 by day and state, for each day from 2025-09-08 through 2025-09-14.
turns.judgmentFocus: Per-day comparison that needs N queries: one state summary per day, union_rows with a day label, then a day by state heatmap. Nothing is paged or re-queried automatically.
